assumptionsAdded: A focused checklist plus publishable receipt is sufficient for an initially useful outcome.
Founders will manually enter statuses and proof without provider integrations.
An unguessable editing link can replace user authentication for the first version.
A free launch is appropriate until willingness to pay is observed.
Publishing a receipt requires persisted state and a stable shareable URL.
Real product usage is useful but not indispensable before testing the concept, so a thin MVP is appropriate.
